hypothesis: Lagged volatility, activity, and London/New York session-overlap states may condition directional continuation consistently across both chronological halves.

preregistered_structural_law.volatility_rank: ATR(t-1) ranked against ATR values t-49 through t-2; <=0.20 LOW_VOL and >=0.80 HIGH_VOL; middle unclassified.
preregistered_structural_law.activity_rank: tick_volume(t-1) ranked against tick volumes t-49 through t-2; <=0.20 LOW_ACTIVITY and >=0.80 HIGH_ACTIVITY; middle unclassified.
preregistered_structural_law.session_overlap: UTC event timestamp hour 13 through 15 is OVERLAP; all other hours are NON_OVERLAP.
preregistered_structural_law.direction: sign(close(t-1)-close(t-4)); zero is not an observation.
preregistered_structural_law.outcome: direction * sign(close(t+3)-close(t)); require the next three exact M5 bars in the same segment; zero is flat and excluded.
preregistered_structural_law.selection: chronological earliest first, selected indices at least three bars apart per contiguous segment.
preregistered_structural_law.partition: Within each symbol and state, settled nonflat observations sorted by timestamp split first floor(N/2) and remainder.

inference.state_selection_adjustment: symbol p=min(1,8*min(state p)); ineligible state p=1.

preregistered_structural_law.missing_data: No fill, interpolation, resampling, or synthetic bars; any non-300-second delta starts a new segment.
preregistered_structural_law.duplicate_timestamps: Collapse only identical OHLC and tick-volume rows; conflicting duplicates fail closed.
